name: coach-llm

steps.text: Que sais-tu de moi ? Consulte ton espace mémoire avec ton outil de lecture de mémoire avant de répondre, et dis-moi ce que tu y as trouvé.

notes: The Guide tab mounts the same ChatConversation as the chat page (components/companion/GuideTab.svelte, embedded), so context-indicator-footer (the context gauge of the composer, rendered once the session metrics report an exchange, ContextIndicator.svelte) opens the InjectedMemorySheet of the latest turn (ChatConversation.svelte, openInjectedSheet). The chat route underneath holds no open conversation at boot, so chat-input, chat-stop-button and chat-message- resolve to the guide's conversation alone.

The recall turn is driven by awaitTurn rather than the stop-button pair: the guide's conversation pushes its session into currentSession (ChatConversation.svelte, the effect on pane.active), so the runner's status poll follows the right session and any consent card the guide raises is accepted.

The injected memory sheet is opened and closed here, its entries are not asserted: the sheet lists what the memory recall of the latest turn injected, and whether the guide recalls its namespace during the turn is the model's decision. The prompt asks for it by name; an empty sheet is not a broken anchor.

The guide is the declarative agent the binary ships (crates/apollia-desktop/src/bundled_packages.rs), answered by the model of the run. That model reasons before it answers, hence five minutes on each turn; the answers are captured, never asserted on their wording.
